# Curve:pointsCount

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the points count of the custom curve.

```lua
local pointsCount = curve:pointsCount([pointsCount])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `pointsCount` | integer | optional |  |
